messages:
omar: quick thread: proposing a hybrid free-list (skiplist for extents + small-bucket arena) to reduce scatter without heavy compaction. want quick gut-check.
sasha: interesting. why skiplist vs buddy?
omar: buddy is great for coalescing but wastes space with power-of-two. skiplist lets us merge arbitrary adjacent extents cheaply and promotes large contiguous runs for big tensors.
devon: how do you handle metadata overhead and lookup latency for hot alloc/free?
omar: small allocations (<16KB) go to fixed-size buckets (per-NUMA). big allocs go through skiplist. skiplist nodes kept in slab per-tenant to avoid cross-tenant locking.
kevin: eviction interplay? if we evict and free an extent, do we immediately try to coalesce into skiplist or delay?
omar: delay coalesce into a maintenance queue. immediate coalesce only if adjacent free and size > threshold. reduces expensive syncs during high churn.
sasha: scoring fragmentation: propose a metric frag_score = 1 - (largest_free_extent / total_free). if >0.6 trigger proactive compaction attempt or suggest quantize.
frag-bot: telemetry: tenant=delta frag_score=0.72, largest_free=48MB, total_free=150MB.
devon: that's useful. what about VA vs residency fragmentation split?
omar: VA fragmentation handled by skiplist; residency by residency-groups (res buckets per device alignment). residency_gap events trigger async offload.
kevin: signals to clients? prefer 429 with structured payload so SDKs can shrink batches. example: `{status:429, code:'FRAG_PRESSURE', retry:2, advise:'reduce_batch'}`
sasha: compaction budget idea: global tokens and per-tenant backoff if you used tokens recently. enterprise tenants get reserved tokens.
omar: yep. and add cheap compact-on-free: when freeing, check neighbor node in skiplist and merge without global lock if same shard.
devon: any failure modes? 
omar: pathological case: many small frees create high skiplist churn. mitigate with merge thresholds and periodic rebuild of free-index during low load.
kevin: testing: synthetic mixed workload (small churn + big tensors) measure alloc_latency_p50/p95, frag_score pre/post, bytes_moved.
sasha: ok spin an RFC with sketches and perf plan. i'll test skiplist impl in a sandbox.
frag-bot: note: scheduled sandbox run for tenant=delta at 04:00 UTC.
omar: thanks all, will draft RFC tonight.
